# Asiyst Subscription Platform & Product Plans
> Official pricing, subscription tiers, and feature entitlement directory for Asiyst AI (https://asiyst.com).

## Canonical Domain & Identity
- Subscription Platform: https://plan.asiyst.com
- Main Application: https://asiyst.com
- Documentation: https://asiyst.com/docs
- Payment Processing: Powered by Dodo Payments (PCI-DSS compliant)

## Subscription Plans Overview

### 1. Asiyst Zero (Free Plan)
- Price: $0.00 / month
- Target Audience: Hobbyists, developers testing Web SDK, and personal projects.
- Key Capabilities:
  - 1 Active Project & 1 Workspace
  - Basic 2.5D visual avatar widget
  - Core website knowledge crawling (up to 10 pages/month)
  - First-party web analytics with 7 days historical retention
  - Community support

### 2. Asiyst Pulse ($24.00 / month)
- Price: $24.00 / month ($240.00 / year with 2 months free)
- Target Audience: Small businesses, solo founders, and growing blogs.
- Key Capabilities:
  - Up to 3 Active Projects & 1 Workspace
  - Full 3D animated glTF avatar character models
  - Knowledge base crawling (up to 100 pages/month)
  - Advanced website analytics (top landing pages, device categories, response latency)
  - 30 days analytics history retention
  - Priority email support

### 3. Asiyst Vector ($54.00 / month)
- Price: $54.00 / month ($540.00 / year with 2 months free)
- Target Audience: E-commerce brands, high-growth SaaS websites, and professional agencies.
- Key Capabilities:
  - Up to 10 Active Projects & 2 Workspaces
  - Custom 3D avatar glTF/GLB file uploads
  - Scheduled automated sitemap crawling (up to 1,000 pages/month)
  - Core Web Vitals health tracking (LCP, INP, CLS)
  - Conversion funnels, cart abandonment analytics, and CSV/JSON/PDF/XLSX export
  - 90 days analytics history retention
  - Webhook dispatch and CRM integrations

### 4. Asiyst Quantum ($154.00 / month)
- Price: $154.00 / month ($1,540.00 / year with 2 months free)
- Target Audience: Enterprise organizations, high-traffic portals, and volume retailers.
- Key Capabilities:
  - Unlimited Projects & 10 Team Workspaces
  - Dedicated multi-project roll-up analytics
  - Statistical anomaly detection & automated traffic drift alerts
  - Weekly visitor retention cohorts & executive AI summary reports
  - 365 days full analytics history retention
  - Unlimited crawling pages & knowledge versioning
  - Full white-label custom domain branding & dedicated SLAs
